description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git notes merging scenarios. It contains test setup, verification functions, and multiple test cases that manipulate Git notes refs, perform merges with different strategies, and verify the integrity and state of notes trees, including fanout structures and conflict resolution.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes for a given reference and commit, comparing to expected files and logs.

methods.name: verify_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree for a reference has a fanout of 1 (full fanout).

methods.name: verify_no_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree for a reference has no fanout.
